title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Vitruvius three tanks: side overflow feeds the public branch while uses remain distinct
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. The source separates three water tanks and recipient uses, with end-tank overflow going to the middle tank and restrictions intended to protect public water. A conditional overflow edge joins otherwise distinct allocation branches. The same water can reach the public branch through overflow without making private and public draws interchangeable.
